physicalNotes: Radius 0.96 +/- 0.006 solar radii from Bonfanti et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 183579 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...671L...8B/abstract): 667,872 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
